title: first-week record/1
description: The first week an instructor marked for a course, kept in a localStorage key of its own so Home can show it: its version `v`, the collection's id, the title in English and Spanish (English at most 120 characters), whether More opens open or shut (`mo`) and one to seven items, each the title (`t`, English at most 200), an address on this site (`h`: one leading slash, no backslash, no space, at most 4,000 characters), and for a lesson its id (`l`), its depth (`d`), its step count (`n`), or for another item whether it was opened (`o`). js/welcome.js readWeek() is the authority and returns nothing, so Home shows no first week, for a record of another version, with no English title, with no items or more than seven, or with an item that is not the right shape. The collection's id is not checked by the reader. FORMATS.md lists it.
